nodes.boundary_definition: A logically isolated virtual network with an IP address range.
nodes.purpose: Defines the address and isolation boundary for the workload.

nodes.boundary_definition: A subnet is an IP range placed within one Availability Zone.
nodes.purpose: Provides a placement and failure-domain boundary.

nodes.boundary_definition: A route table selects a target for traffic leaving a subnet; gateways provide selected connectivity paths.
nodes.purpose: Explains how packets move between tiers and outside the VPC.

nodes.boundary_definition: A route-table-integrated private path from a VPC to a supported AWS service, without traversing an internet gateway or NAT gateway.
nodes.purpose: Helps choose a narrower private service path when the dependency is supported.

nodes.boundary_definition: A workload placement decision based on whether direct inbound internet reachability is required.
nodes.purpose: Limits exposure while preserving required connectivity.

nodes.boundary_definition: Two different traffic-control layers with different attachment points and state behavior.
nodes.purpose: Provides least-exposure controls and a diagnosis contrast.

nodes.boundary_definition: A request appears permitted in one direction but fails because the reverse path or stateless rule is absent.
nodes.purpose: Makes stateful versus stateless behavior operationally testable.

nodes.boundary_definition: Place replaceable workload capacity across separate Availability Zones and test the failure assumption.
nodes.purpose: Connects subnet placement to recovery from a zone disruption.

nodes.boundary_definition: Explain the roles and relationships of the core VPC objects.
nodes.purpose: Foundation for all later design work.

nodes.boundary_definition: Design routes and placement so only required paths exist.
nodes.purpose: Applies network concepts to an architecture.

nodes.boundary_definition: Use observed symptoms to identify the failing control or path.
Explain how the design behaves under a zone-level disruption and what it does not guarantee.
nodes.purpose: Tests resilience reasoning rather than diagram memorization.
